choices.why: This pale birch table, 125 x 74 cm, seats four comfortably in the free space beside the kitchenette, and its simple Nordic lines match the light-wood kitchen fronts.
The black spindle-back chair is a classic Nordic design and stands out cleanly against the light table and pale floor.
This plain off-white metal dome pendant suits the Nordic style and blends with the white walls and upper cabinets while marking the dining area.
Its white body disappears against the white wall, and the pale wood fronts repeat the birch table and kitchen wood, so it stays light and simple.

answer.why: Pale birch and light wood tie the table and sideboard to the kitchenette and the grey wood floor, while the black spindle chairs add contrast. The white dome pendant keeps the whole look bright, minimal and Nordic.
